requirements.statement: `root:test_setup_straight` (4 fragments) totals at most 230 s, measured as the sum of its fragments' seconds (what the budget check counts), with full-run parallelism (`--jobs 16` beside `codex:tests.test_project_driver` and `root:test_install`).

the lost-run test helpers `counted` and `claimed_bindings` read the account's tables under the ledger lock, never between the statements of an open account write (the load flake of the lost-run tests).
no assertion is removed or weakened. Every changed assertion, renamed test or changed fixture behaviour is paired old -> new in [`testspeed2/assertions.md`](testspeed2/assertions.md).
